name: COP-34 Financial Assistance to Farmer for Interest Subvention (Kishan Credit Card Interest Asst.)
benefit: **Name of Component** **Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Year) for Reclaiming Benefits**COP-34, Financial assistance to farmer for Interest Subvention4% interest subvention on timely repayment of crop loan taken by farmers up to ₹3,00,000/-only once in a financial year
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The farmer should have taken a short-term crop loan during the Kharif season (1st April to 30th September) from any of the following:

  - Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Society
  - District Central Cooperative Bank
  - Nationalized Bank
  - Gramin Bank
  - Private Bank

1. The farmer should have repaid the loan on time.
